term.description: 技能持续拥有两段计量槽，技能进行到一半时触发额外效果

mapping: The selected forty-second duration is the full two-bar window. Natural overload begins at twenty seconds. A marked target leaving range skips remaining first-phase time and leaves at most twenty seconds. This duration-to-two-bar accounting and compiled ForceEnterSkillOverloadProgress ordering remain explicit local mappings.
